title: Create Floor Slab Command
description: Create one closed Brep slab from horizontal coordinate polygons. outer[0].z is the top elevation and positive thickness goes downward in world -Z. Units are document units.

holes.description: Holes strictly inside the outer polygon, with no crossing, touching or nesting

layer.description: Existing layer full path or GUID; default is current layer

polygon.description: Ordered [x,y,z] vertices; closing vertex is optional; all Z values must equal the outer top elevation within document tolerance
